# FrameDecks 9.3 (production audit M5): every package the Windows build installs, at the exact version in
# packaging/constraints.txt, with the SHA-256 of each file PyPI serves for it. The build installs this file with
# --require-hashes, so a changed or substituted package fails the build. Made for Windows and Python 3.12 with:
#   uv pip compile packaging/requirements-desktop.txt -c packaging/constraints.txt --python-platform windows \
#     --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes --no-header -o packaging/requirements-lock.txt
# (then put this note back). tests/test_build_lock.py checks it matches constraints.txt and requirements-desktop.txt.
